values.note: City of Mitchell: RV sites with hookups $41 a night or $535 a month, plus local fees and taxes; tent sites $26, with electricity $28.

note: City of Mitchell campground on a wooded peninsula of Lake Mitchell, off Hwy 37 on the north edge of Mitchell; RV loops sit back in the trees, tent sites take the point. Swim beach, paddle boats and pontoon rental, hiking and bike trails, playground. Campground hosts in summer. --Claude
summary: City page + official map + imagery read: 48 hookup RV sites (30/50 A, full hookups on most), 9 tent; $41/night, $535/month; year-round with water/comfort station off mid-Oct to late Apr/May; online via camping.com (closes 48 h out), walk-ins at self-pay. Not waterfront confirmed. Phone missing -> 605-432-8795.
